scenes.title: Welcome to Shapes
scenes.narration: Welcome to Fun with Shapes! Everywhere we look around us, in our school and in our village, shapes make our world wonderful and strong.
scenes.subtitles: Welcome to Fun with Shapes! Shapes make our world wonderful and strong.

scenes.title: The Circle
scenes.narration: First, meet the circle. A circle is perfectly round. It has one curved edge and zero corners. Because it has no corners, it can roll smoothly. Think of a bicycle wheel or a round chapati!
scenes.onScreenText:
Circle
• 1 Curved Edge
• 0 Corners
• Rolls Smoothly
scenes.subtitles: A circle is perfectly round with 1 curved edge and zero corners. It rolls smoothly like a wheel.

scenes.title: The Triangle
scenes.narration: Next is the triangle. A triangle has three straight sides and three sharp corners called vertices. In our village, roof tops and temple flags are triangular because triangles are extra strong!
scenes.onScreenText:
Triangle
• 3 Straight Sides
• 3 Vertices (Corners)
• Strong & Rigid
scenes.subtitles: A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 vertices. Triangles give village roofs great strength.

scenes.title: Squares and Rectangles
scenes.narration: Here are squares and rectangles. Both have four straight sides and four square corners. A square has four equal sides, while a rectangle has opposite sides equal. Notice how bricks and doors are rectangles so they stack neatly!
scenes.onScreenText:
Squares & Rectangles
• 4 Straight Sides
• 4 Right Angles
• Perfect for Stacking
scenes.subtitles: Squares and rectangles have 4 straight sides. Flat rectangular bricks stack tightly into sturdy walls.

scenes.title: Takeaways
scenes.narration: Remember: 2D shapes are flat, while 3D shapes like spheres and cubes take up space. Keep exploring the shapes all around your village!
scenes.onScreenText:
Shapes Are Everywhere!
Explore • Observe • Learn
scenes.subtitles: Remember: 2D shapes are flat, while 3D shapes take up space. Keep exploring shapes around you!
